question: Does the fixed P5P minimax measured-total MTF envelope remain severe-artifact-clean, nonempty and structurally useful on the frozen 18-photo/9-camera P5D OOD cohort when scanner MTF remains a separate common downstream stage?

input.domain_use: relative-display-sRGB-derived pseudo-exposure for structural and severe-artifact stress only

pipeline.control_sensitometry_only: fixed U2.2 sensitometry to transmittance plus unchanged scanner MTF
pipeline.control_generic_p5c: exact retained P5C generic film spatial chain plus unchanged scanner MTF
pipeline.candidate: exact P5P minimax transmittance envelope replacing generic film spatial stages, plus unchanged scanner MTF
pipeline.uncertainty: P5P pointwise placement half-range before scanner MTF
pipeline.single_final_preview_encoding: deterministic sRGB8 PNG for visual evidence only

severe_vetoes: red, green or blue speckle or posterization
objectionable colour fringing or edge echo
banding, clipping or flat-region colour blocks

branch_rule.pass: Retain photographic severe/OOD development evidence and open a separately frozen value comparison against the generic control.
branch_rule.fail: Close P5P for photographic use and retain P5L/P5O/P5P as synthetic reference evidence only.

forbidden: change P5P, P5D, P5C, sensitometry, scanner or gates after results
select one P5O arm from photo appearance
use visual review after automatic failure
treat pseudo-exposure as scene exposure or the candidate as identified physical MTF placement
claim stock, process, scanner, calibrated or product response
integrate into production from this stress alone
claim_ceiling: Photographic structural and severe-artifact stress for one film-inspired placement-uncertainty MTF challenger on display-derived pseudo-exposure; not physical placement, calibrated stock response, preference or product promotion.
